nodes.description: Storage.State holding epoch, balance (supply/bonded/staged/redeemable/debt/coupons), provider and per-account/epoch/candidate mappings
Storage.State13 (DIP-13) holding couponUnderlyingByAccount, couponUnderlying and the cached oracle price
Storage.State16 (DIP-16) holding legacyOracle and epochStartForSushiswapPool
Upgradeable.setImplementation(address) - validates the address is a contract and writes the EIP-1967 implementation slot via inline assembly sstore
Upgradeable.upgradeTo(address) - sets the new implementation then delegatecalls initialize() on it and emits Upgraded
Govern.commit(address) - standard governance finalisation; checks quorum and approval then calls upgradeTo(candidate)
Govern.emergencyCommit(address) - super-majority fast-track governance finalisation then calls upgradeTo(candidate)
Govern.vote(address,Candidate.Vote) - records/updates a vote, may create a candidate, updates approve/reject tallies and places a lock
Implementation.advance() external incentivized - drives Bonding.step, Regulator.step and Market.step and emits Advance
Implementation.incentivized modifier - reads Chainlink gas/ETH prices, converts to DSD cost and mints the advance reward to msg.sender
Market.migrateCoupons(uint256) external - converts legacy coupon balance into coupon underlying at a 1/2 ratio
Market.purchaseCoupons(uint256) external - burns DSD debt and issues coupon plus underlying to msg.sender
Market.redeemCoupons(uint256,uint256,uint256) external - redeems coupon underlying during expansion, applying a time-based penalty burn
Market.approveCoupons(address,uint256) external - sets coupon allowance for a spender
Market.transferCoupons(address,address,uint256,uint256) external - moves coupon underlying/coupons and consumes coupon allowance
Bonding.deposit(uint256) external - pulls DSD with transferFrom and credits staged balance
Bonding.withdraw(uint256) external onlyFrozenOrLocked - sends DSD with transfer then decrements staged balance
Bonding.bond(uint256) external onlyFrozenOrFluid - converts staged DSD into bonded DSDS stake
Bonding.unbond(uint256) external onlyFrozenOrFluid - burns bonded stake and returns staged DSD
Bonding.unbondUnderlying(uint256) external onlyFrozenOrFluid - burns stake specified in underlying DSD terms
Bonding.step() internal - requires the epoch to have elapsed then snapshots total bonded and increments the epoch
Regulator.step() internal - captures oracle price, stores it and branches to grow/shrink/neutral supply
Market.step() internal - expires prior coupons and registers the current epoch's coupon expiration
Regulator.growSupply(Decimal.D256) private - resets debt, computes limited delta and mints new supply
Regulator.shrinkSupply(Decimal.D256) private - computes limited delta and increases system debt
Regulator.oracleCapture() private - calls IOracle.capture() returning the price for the current epoch
Comptroller.increaseSupply(uint256) internal - distributes new supply to pool, treasury, redeemable and DAO
Comptroller.increaseDebt(uint256) internal - adds debt then resets it against the debt ratio cap
Comptroller.decreaseDebt(uint256) internal - reduces outstanding debt and runs balanceCheck
Comptroller.resetDebt(Decimal.D256) internal - reduces debt down to the target debt ratio
Comptroller.mintToAccount(address,uint256) internal - mints DSD to an account and increases debt when not bootstrapping
Comptroller.burnFromAccount(address,uint256) internal - pulls DSD with transferFrom then burns it and reduces debt
Comptroller.redeemToAccount(address,uint256,uint256) internal - mints redeemed DSD and transfers coupon premium
Comptroller.burnRedeemable(uint256) internal - burns DSD and decrements total redeemable
Comptroller.balanceCheck() private - Require.that invariant that contract DSD balance covers bonded+staged+redeemable
Comptroller.mintToDAO(uint256) private - mints DSD to the contract and increments total bonded
Comptroller.mintToTreasury(uint256) private - mints DSD to the treasury address
Comptroller.mintToPool(uint256) private - mints DSD to the configured pool address
Comptroller.mintToRedeemable(uint256) private - mints DSD to the contract and increments total redeemable
Market.couponPremium(uint256) public view - returns the coupon premium for an amount
Market.couponRedemptionPenalty(uint256,uint256) public view - time-in-epoch dependent penalty on coupon redemption
Implementation.initialize() public initializer - wires the new sushi oracle and pool, sets legacy oracle and mints initial allocations
Getters.blockTimestamp() internal view - returns block.timestamp, overridable for testing
Getters.epochTimeWithStrategy(Constants.EpochStrategy) private view - derives the current epoch from blockTimestamp()
Comptroller.setPrice(Decimal.D256) internal - stores the oracle price into _state13.price
Setters.snapshotTotalBonded() internal - records total supply as the bonded snapshot for the current epoch
Setters.incrementEpoch() internal - advances _state.epoch.current by one
Setters.unfreeze(address) internal - sets the account fluidUntil to now plus DAO exit lockup
Market.expireCouponsForEpoch(uint256) private - eliminates outstanding coupons, burns excess redeemable and mints new supply
Setters.initializeCouponsExpiration(uint256,uint256) internal - records expiration and pushes into the expiring list
Setters.eliminateOutstandingCoupons(uint256) internal - zeroes outstanding coupons for an epoch and reduces total coupons
Regulator.limit(Decimal.D256,Decimal.D256) private view - caps the supply-change delta at the configured limit
Govern.canPropose(address) private view - checks stake ratio against the governance proposal threshold
Setters.placeLock(address,address) internal - extends the account lockedUntil to the candidate end
Setters.recordVote(address,address,Candidate.Vote) internal - persists the account vote for a candidate
Setters.incrementBalanceOf(address,uint256) internal - credits account balance and total supply and emits Transfer
Setters.decrementBalanceOf(address,uint256,string) internal - debits account balance and total supply and emits Transfer
Setters.incrementBalanceOfStaged(address,uint256) internal - credits staged balance
Setters.decrementBalanceOfStaged(address,uint256,string) internal - debits staged balance
Setters.incrementBalanceOfCoupons(address,uint256,uint256) internal - credits epoch coupons and outstanding counters
Setters.decrementBalanceOfCoupons(address,uint256,uint256,string) internal - debits epoch coupons and outstanding counters
Setters.incrementBalanceOfCouponUnderlying(address,uint256,uint256) internal - credits DIP-13 coupon underlying
Setters.decrementBalanceOfCouponUnderlying(address,uint256,uint256,string) internal - debits DIP-13 coupon underlying
Setters.updateAllowanceCoupons(address,address,uint256) internal - sets the coupon allowance
Setters.decrementAllowanceCoupons(address,address,uint256,string) internal - reduces the coupon allowance
Setters.createCandidate(address,uint256) internal - initialises candidate start and period
Setters.incrementApproveFor(address,uint256) internal - adds to the candidate approve tally
Setters.decrementApproveFor(address,uint256,string) internal - subtracts from the candidate approve tally
Setters.incrementRejectFor(address,uint256) internal - adds to the candidate reject tally
Setters.decrementRejectFor(address,uint256,string) internal - subtracts from the candidate reject tally
Setters.initialized(address) internal - marks a candidate/implementation as initialised
Curve.calculateCouponPremium(uint256,uint256,uint256) internal pure - applies the effective premium to the amount
Curve.effectivePremium(uint256,uint256,uint256) private pure - computes the debt-ratio based premium with the debt ratio cap
Curve.curve(Decimal.D256) private pure - 1/(3(1-R)^2)-1/3 curve evaluation
Curve.curveMean(Decimal.D256,Decimal.D256) private pure - 1/(3(1-R)(1-R'))-1/3 curve evaluation

incentive (Decimal.D256) computed in the incentivized modifier
ethSpent (Decimal.D256) gas cost in wei computed in the incentivized modifier
